name: S ljubov'ju iz carstva nochi
source:
Being in debt to an influential merchant, a young veteran Alexander agrees to a strange deal: to take an orphan girl to an abandoned forest station and thus redeem the debt. The task turns into a real adventure, because the nights in the Black Earth region are dark and cold.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610330/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
年轻的退伍军人亚历山大欠了一位有影响力的商人的债，他同意达成一项奇怪的协议：将一名孤女带到一个废弃的森林站，从而偿还债务。这项任务变成了一次真正的冒险，因为黑土地区的夜晚又黑又冷。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1610330/]Steam[/url]]
